phase.human_name: живой runtime в реальном Cursor UI
phase.status: blocked until local unlock/login, but scenario prep can be completed

preconditions: Windows locally unlocked by user; no PIN/password captured.
Cursor target window '[Extension Development Host] cursor-xiigen-smart-skills - Cursor' visible.
If Cursor login required, open browser login only if user is present; agent stops before credential entry.
After user completes login, rerun preflight before prompt submission.
Storage Error modal must be screenshotted first; destructive options are forbidden unless separately authorized.
exact_prompt: Проверь короткий запрос: "Нужно составить понятный план проверки API-дешборда без привязки к конкретному стеку". Сформируй универсальную задачу, предложи план оркестрации и выбери подходящие скилы из доступных.

path_a.label: Path A
path_a.goal: Run or reference the non-UI Cursor adapter boundary path with the same redacted prompt.

path_b.label: Path B
path_b.goal: Use the real Cursor Extension Development Host UI after unlock/login with the same exact prompt.
steps: Find the target Cursor window by title, pid, handle, and bounds.
Capture screenshot of the active target window.
Resolve login/storage modal only under the safe precondition rules.
Open XIIGen Smart Skills through command palette, panel, or chat participant route.
Save core trace or correlation id if available.
expected_visible_markers: XIIGen Smart Skills route or label is visible.
The response shows structured task, orchestration plan, selected skills, or a core warning/error.
The result is not a UI-only fake response without core trace.

PASS: Path A and Path B use the same exact prompt.
Path A includes XiigenExtensionRequest, RequestedSkills, AvailableSkills, core response, and no host selector/scorer.
Path B shows prompt before submit and response after submit in real Cursor UI screenshots.
Trace or correlation id connects UI run to core call.
PARTIAL: Path A passed but Path B has incomplete UI evidence.
Path B shows response but trace/correlation id is missing.
Core returned a visible warning/error rather than a full success response.
BLOCKED_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Windows, Cursor, or browser requests login, PIN, password, 2FA, or another secret.
BLOCKED_STORAGE_MODAL: Storage Error modal blocks the scenario and no safe non-destructive action is clear.
TARGET_WINDOW_NOT_FOUND: The target Cursor Extension Development Host window is absent from window inventory.
RESPONSE_NOT_VISIBLE: Prompt was submitted but no visible response appeared in Cursor UI.
CORE_TRACE_MISSING: UI response is visible but no core request/response/trace/correlation id proves llm_mvp_core involvement.

format_requirements: All text files UTF-8 no BOM.
